entries.تحتاج الشركات إلى إدارة بيانات الموظفين: Companies need to manage employee data, shifts, attendance, leave, permissions, payroll, and financial requests within a single operational cycle while ensuring attendance takes place at the correct location and time, reducing manipulation opportunities, and isolating each company’s data and permissions. entries.تم بناء دواماتيك كمنصة SaaS متعددة الشرك: Dawamatic was built as a multi-company SaaS platform that combines HR, attendance, and workforce management in one centralized system. It provides company operations dashboards for managing employees, organizational structure, contracts, locations, shifts, attendance, requests, payroll, and financial operations, plus a mobile employee app for clock-in/out, schedules, requests, and payslips. Attendance is validated against geolocation, shift, device, and security policies, with suspicious-case review, corrections, and auditable history. The platform also connects leave, permissions, and overtime with attendance, Payroll Lite, advances, loans, claims, and offboarding, and includes a separate dashboard for Dawamatic platform administration, subscribed companies, plans, subscriptions, and operations.
